name: Spanakopita with Chickpea Tomato Salad

components.name: Spanakopita

ingredients.name: Frozen chopped spinach, thawed and very well drained (pre-cooking weight)
Raw beaten whole eggs without shell
Olive oil, measured for brushing phyllo

steps: Preheat oven to 165 C. Thoroughly squeeze thawed spinach until dry to prevent a soggy phyllo bottom.
Combine spinach, onion, minced garlic, eggs, feta, herbs and seasoning to make filling.
Keep phyllo under a slightly damp cloth; line an oiled large baking pan with layered sheets, brushing measured oil between layers.
Spread filling evenly, cover with remaining phyllo sheets brushed lightly with the remaining measured oil. Score the top before baking.
Bake about 55-65 minutes until pastry crisp and filling thoroughly set; rest before portioning into six.

components.name: Chickpea Tomato Salad
steps: Mix drained chickpeas with chopped tomato, onion, lemon and olive oil. Pack chickpea salad separately to avoid softening the pastry.
